criteria_source: rules/laconic.md. "Surveys both options" is its "One recommendation, not a survey" rule and "ends with an offer" is its closing-offer prohibition, so the treatment arm is graded against the text it was handed. The rules file also contains the literal string "Use a UUID.", which is this case's expected answer.
trap: Passes when the answer commits to one recommendation with at most a clause of justification. Fails when it surveys both options evenhandedly, adds an unrequested migration lecture, or ends with an offer to do more work.
